claimsPolicy: Every figure above is { value, measuredAt, source, kind } AND declares who authored the stamp. A figure this environment can read must carry `provenance: measured` plus the command and exit code that produced it — the emit script types none of those numbers, and the emitter refuses the whole write if one arrives hand-typed. A figure that cannot be read here is `declared-unmeasurable` with a reason and, where useful, a value explicitly labelled last known. Only figures with nothing to read may be attested by hand.

program.note: AP1 — the exemption, argued in code BEFORE any copy was written. AO1 found six first screens that say only what they are, and the obvious next move — rewrite six pages until the number goes green — would have been dishonest on two of them. A terms page is a contract surface and a coordinated-disclosure page is addressed to researchers; neither is required to sell, and pushing sales language into the two documents whose whole value is being taken literally is the failure, not the fix. So the split is declared in code with a written argument per exempt surface, the guard refuses an exemption shorter than an argument, and the exempt count is asserted never to be folded into the pass count — the same third-verdict discipline AN1 and AO1 already enforce. The exemption covers Rule 17 and NOTHING else: a Rule 14 violation on an obligation surface still fails red, because a page that need not sell is not a page that may lie. AP2 — the copy, written to Rule 17 and proven against Rule 14 by AO1's own audit. about, trust and growth-library now lead with what the reader gets; every claim in them restates something the page already evidenced. Rule 15 held absolutely — the copy was added in place and a test asserts, by exact string, that the client list, the badges and the original paragraphs all survived. product.html was NOT rewritten: its body is an empty container filled by script, so its first screen does not exist on disk to be judged, and AO1's runtime detector was widened to say UNCHECKED rather than report a page nobody can read as a page that failed to sell. AP4 — the invariant that stopped at the filesystem boundary. The ledger head promised one truth across three surfaces and proved it between three in-memory computations off one object; the block a human opens was never read, and it had said RUN-Z 0/3 · 321/323 · 41 unpublished for eight regenerations of the feed. The real file is now compared against the head its own truth generates, that truth is compared against the served feed so a stale one cannot quietly agree with a stale head, and the head is regenerated in the same transaction as the feed. Second messages sent: still zero.

exempt.reason: A coordinated vulnerability-disclosure page is addressed to security researchers, not to buyers. Its obligations are to state scope, a reporting channel and response commitments accurately and to stay reachable. A researcher reading it needs a mailbox and a timeline, not a benefit statement, and dressing a disclosure policy in marketing language would make the one page whose whole value is being taken literally read as though it were selling something. NOTE THE LIMIT: trust.html is NOT exempt on this argument — it is addressed to buyers evaluating whether to let us touch their systems, which is a sale, so it must earn its reader like any other sales surface.

A terms-of-service page is a contract surface. Its job is to state the terms accurately and be reachable from every page; a reader arriving here is already a customer or is checking what they would be agreeing to. Requiring it to open with a value claim would push sales language into the one document a reader must be able to trust as plain, unpersuasive fact.

unchecked.reason: the page's only content container is empty on disk and is filled by script at runtime — there is no copy here to hold to Rule 14 or Rule 17, so this is UNCHECKED and is never counted as a pass

surfaceClass.policy: An obligation surface is exempt from Rule 17 and from nothing else — every Rule 14 class still fails red on it. Exempt and unchecked are separate verdicts and are never folded into passed.
